name: GeneSPIDER2
simulation_summary: Generates signed GeneSPIDER2 regulatory networks and perturbation-based bulk, bulk time-series or single-cell RNA expression data through the public MATLAB API, packaged as a MATLAB Compiler application for MATLAB Runtime execution.

conditional_required.usage: Wrapper reads this signed regulator-target TSV into a GeneSPIDER network matrix A(target, regulator) when network_source=input_tsv.

compatibility_rules.message: Single-cell group truth requires single_cell.n_clusts >= 2 so public groups and group truth contexts are meaningful.
num_genes must equal the number of unique genes in regulatory_network when network_source=input_tsv.
time_series.perturbed_gene_index must reference one of the generated or input network genes.

threading.upstream_mapping: The MATLAB entrypoint calls maxNumCompThreads(runtime_resources.threads) before invoking public GeneSPIDER2 generation functions. The Docker runtime executes a MATLAB Compiler binary on MATLAB Runtime; no MATLAB license is required at run time.

network_source.description: Selects the GRN source. scalefree2 calls the public GeneSPIDER2 datastruct.scalefree2 generator; input_tsv loads the regulatory_network simulator input. The CVX-backed large_scalefree/stabilize route is not exposed because it is not portable in the MATLAB Runtime package.

num_genes.description: Number of genes in generated networks, or the expected number of unique genes when network_source=input_tsv.

average_degree.description: Average network degree passed as S/grn_degree to GeneSPIDER network generators.

scalefree2_alpha.description: Power-law alpha passed to datastruct.scalefree2 when network_source=scalefree2.

activation_probability.description: Probability that generated edges are positive activations; GeneSPIDER defaults to 0.62 based on TRRUST.

perturbation.description: Generated knockdown perturbation-design controls. The wrapper builds P = -strength * repmat(eye(num_genes), 1, replicates_per_gene).

replicates_per_gene.description: Number of perturbation columns/cells generated per gene.

strength.description: Positive knockdown strength; the wrapper writes negative perturbation values in P.

bulk.description: Bulk perturbational noise controls mapped to datastruct.noise.

snr.description: Signal-to-noise ratio passed to datastruct.noise for bulk perturbational output.

single_cell.description: Options passed to datastruct.scdata for perturbed single-cell simulation.

snr.description: Signal-to-noise ratio for Gaussian expression noise in datastruct.scdata.

control_snr.description: Signal-to-noise ratio for pseudo-control count noise, mapped to scdata SNRc.

raw_counts.description: Maps to scdata raw_counts. true emits raw count-like values; false emits log fold-change values.

right_tail.description: Power applied to the pseudo-control negative-binomial tail in scdata.

negbin_prob.description: Negative-binomial probability used to simulate pseudo-control means.

dispersion.description: Dropout dispersion parameter mapped to scdata disper.

n_clusts.description: Theoretical number of clusters passed to scdata. Group truth requires at least 2.

logbase.description: Logarithm base used when reversing fold changes in scdata; also affects perturbation strength.

ds_min.description: Minimum dissimilarity between theoretical clusters in scdata.

ds_max.description: Maximum dissimilarity between theoretical clusters in scdata.

grouping.description: Wrapper grouping presets for capabilities that require public groups.

method.description: Derive groups by deterministic k-means clustering on the generated expression matrix.

time_series.description: Options for datastruct.simts bulk time-series simulations.

time_points.description: Maps to datastruct.simts tids. The wrapper exports the initial state plus tids simulated time points.

perturbed_gene_index.description: One-based gene index whose perturbation vector entry is set for datastruct.simts.

perturbation_strength.description: Value assigned to the selected entry of the simts perturbation vector p.

input_noise_std.description: Maps to datastruct.simts stdp, the standard deviation of input noise at each time step.

upstream_configuration: network_source=scalefree2 calls datastruct.scalefree2(num_genes, average_degree, alpha=network.scalefree2_alpha, pasign=network.activation_probability).
The CVX-backed large_scalefree/stabilize route is intentionally not exposed in the ANDREA runtime package.
network_source=input_tsv loads regulatory_network into A(target, regulator).
truth_contexts.generation: The wrapper normalizes every non-zero non-diagonal A(target, regulator) entry into truth/networks.csv with context=global, source=regulator and target=target.
truth_contexts.score_semantics: score is abs(A[target, regulator]); sign is + for positive activation effects and - for negative repression effects.
limitations: The public scalefree2 generator determines the signed edge magnitudes exported as truth.
Diagonal self-degradation/stability terms are excluded from public GRN truth.
Custom input_tsv truth uses the loaded matrix and does not prove upstream biological validity.

truth_contexts.explanation: This capability does not request or export group truth contexts.
GeneSPIDER2 uses one fixed GRN for all expression columns; no per-column GRN state is emitted.

native_outputs.description: Signed GeneSPIDER GRN matrix A used to generate the dataset.
Perturbation design matrix P used for steady-state response simulation.
Bulk perturbational expression response Y = Net.G * P + Gaussian noise.
Gaussian expression-noise matrix E generated by datastruct.noise.

derivations.method: Export every public expression gene identifier as extras/enrichment_background.txt, one gene per line.
assumptions: The generated expression feature set is the correct background universe for downstream analyses.
limitations: The background is synthetic and dataset-derived, not an organism-specific annotation universe.

derivations.method: Export the same non-diagonal GRN edges used for global truth into extras/prior_grn.tsv with source, target, score and sign.
assumptions: The selected simulator GRN can serve as an oracle structural prior only when explicitly requested.
limitations: This is truth-derived and not an independent noisy prior.

derivations.method: Export unique public source/regulator identifiers from non-zero non-diagonal GRN edges, one per line.
assumptions: Regulators in the simulated GRN define the synthetic TF/regulator universe.
limitations: The TF list is simulator-derived and not an external organism-specific TF catalogue.

derivations.method: For each expression column, inspect the corresponding perturbation-design vector and export the perturbed public gene IDs and signed perturbation strengths.
assumptions: Each generated column is assumed to have a well-defined perturbation-design column in P.
limitations: Generated designs currently represent direct single-gene knockdown/perturbation columns; arbitrary future P matrices may need richer intervention metadata.

derivations.method: Assign replicate labels by grouping expression columns that share the same perturbed gene and perturbation strength.
assumptions: Columns generated from repeated identity perturbation blocks are replicate-like observations for the same intervention.
limitations: Replicate labels are generated from the wrapper design, not returned as a separate upstream table.

simts models one perturbation vector over time and does not emit timepoint-specific rewiring.

truth_contexts.explanation: Bulk time-series output has no public groups.
Expression columns are timepoints sharing one fixed GRN; GeneSPIDER2 does not emit timepoint-specific GRNs.

derivations.method: Write every public expression gene ID to extras/enrichment_background.txt.
assumptions: The tested gene universe is the expression row universe.
limitations: No independent pathway universe is simulated.

derivations.method: For each expression column, inspect the corresponding perturbation-design vector and export the perturbed public gene IDs and signed perturbation strengths.
assumptions: Each generated column is assumed to have a well-defined perturbation-design column in P.
limitations: Generated designs currently represent direct single-gene knockdown/perturbation columns; arbitrary future P matrices may need richer intervention metadata.

derivations.method: Export global truth edges as an oracle prior in extras/prior_grn.tsv.
assumptions: The selected GRN is the upstream simulated regulatory network.
limitations: This is a truth-derived oracle prior, not an independently observed prior.

derivations.method: Export source/regulator genes with at least one non-zero outgoing edge.
assumptions: Regulators are represented by non-zero source columns in A.
limitations: Genes without outgoing simulated edges are omitted even if biologically TF-like.

derivations.method: Recompute the simts timestep tau*0.1 from min(abs(eig(A))) and export t0 plus each simulated timepoint in column order.
assumptions: The wrapper uses the same timestep formula as datastruct.simts.
limitations: The upstream function returns expression states but not an explicit metadata table; the timepoint table is wrapper-derived.

upstream_configuration: Wrapper calls datastruct.scdata(A, P, ..., n_clusts=single_cell.n_clusts) to generate clustered single-cell expression.

GeneSPIDER2 clustered expression does not imply group-specific GRN rewiring.

upstream_configuration: grouping.method=kmeans_expression derives public groups from the generated expression matrix because datastruct.scdata does not return native cluster labels.
truth_contexts.generation: The wrapper derives groups.tsv by deterministic expression clustering into single_cell.n_clusts groups, then duplicates global truth rows into one context=group:<group_id> network per observed group.
truth_contexts.score_semantics: Group truth uses the same score and sign as the fixed global truth edge.
limitations: Group labels are wrapper-derived rather than native GeneSPIDER outputs.
All group networks are identical because GeneSPIDER2 uses one fixed GRN for the run.

derivations.method: Cluster cells deterministically into single_cell.n_clusts groups using grouping.method=kmeans_expression on the normalized expression matrix, then write cell_id and group_id to extras/groups.tsv.
assumptions: GeneSPIDER2 scdata is explicitly designed to produce clustered single-cell structure controlled by n_clusts.
Expression-derived groups are acceptable because upstream does not return the internal theoretical cluster labels.
limitations: Groups are derived by the wrapper and can differ from GeneSPIDER2's internal shuffled theoretical cluster blocks.

derivations.method: Write one phenotype label per cell using the derived group_id.
assumptions: Derived groups are the only public cell-state labels for this integration.
limitations: Phenotypes are synthetic cluster labels, not named biological cell types.

derivations.method: Write one row per derived group with a stable synthetic cluster label.
assumptions: Derived group IDs define the cluster identity universe.
limitations: No upstream biological annotations are available.

derivations.method: Duplicate the global prior GRN once per derived public group and write group_id, source, target, score and sign.
assumptions: GeneSPIDER2 uses a fixed GRN across derived groups, so a group-specific oracle prior is identical by construction.
limitations: This is not evidence of group-specific regulatory rewiring.

derivations.method: For each observed derived group_id, duplicate the global truth edge set into context=group:<group_id>.
assumptions: The fixed-GRN model means every derived group shares the same regulatory truth.
limitations: Group truth is wrapper-derived and identical across groups.
